notes: All non-spending rows retain DB required confirmed_category=UNCLASSIFIED, but normalized API category is null.
source_detail and balance_after are null; do not invent balances or real provider credentials.
C zero known sums for months without coverage are NOT actual zero spending.
current category remaining display policy and rounding are pending; raw signed difference is arithmetic only.
first A/B cycle before July has incomplete coverage; never claim historical June cycle spending complete.
Do not run the backend classification pipeline over prelabelled gold rows.
Fixed rows require RecurringExpense + PaymentDue + PaymentMatch; funding is not a FinancialTransaction DB field.
excluded_same_purchase is represented by TransactionLink, not a new DB field.
Existing migrations require PostgreSQL with pgvector; no SQLite substitution.
All times including historical created/approved/confirmed fields must be deterministic and no later than as_of. auto_now_add fields need seed-specific postcreation adjustment.
RecurringExpense payment_card null; fixed bills use bank payment. Every fixed transaction has exactly one PaymentDue/PaymentMatch in baseline.
No actual provider call, bank credentials, card bills or account balance reconciliation is simulated in this baseline.
Budget 1~9 analysis integration and current partial-coverage response contract are not yet implemented; failing missing-feature tests must be labelled accordingly, not bypassed.

C_current.draft_v1: Use persona C category_budget_won; approved_at null; no approved version.
C_current.variant_approved: Separate scenario only, never mixed into baseline.

ml_stage.reason: baseline tests arithmetic using preapproved synthetic snapshots and manually confirmed category labels
ml_stage.disposable_income: No assumed mapping from take_home_income; DB null until model feature definition is agreed.
ml_stage.weights: Obtain trusted version from model owner; never load unverified joblib.
ml_stage.ETC: Budget has 11 categories while model predicts 10; model living input should exclude ETC only after agreed adapter contract.
ml_stage.fixed_input: Model fixed_expense_amount covers housing utilities fuel telecommunications, not all service fixed spending; A candidate 700000, B 650000 (excludes car insurance), C 50000 (excludes education). These are proposed mappings, not executed inference.
